summary: MyAPES Portal is now MyAPES at /myapes, and it is set up to send from news@myapes.me.uk.
detailed_changes: The MyAPES Portal newsletter and channel are renamed MyAPES. The channel page and feed move to /myapes and /myapes/rss.xml, and the old /myapes-portal links, feed and signup page redirect permanently, so existing bookmarks and subscriptions keep working (#630).

The myapes.me.uk sending domain now uses myapes.me.uk itself as its Mailgun domain, so the MyAPES newsletter can send from news@myapes.me.uk and still pass the domain's strict DMARC checks. The domain goes back to pending until Mailgun and DNS are verified, and its mail for MyAPES Account is unchanged (#598).
affected_areas: User groups affected: readers of the MyAPES newsletter, admins (sending domains), staff (newsletters)
Public impact: the MyAPES channel has a new name and address; old links redirect
Internal impact: two data migrations (newsletter rename, myapes.me.uk Mailgun domain), docs/email-sending-domains.md runbook
